# AirPDF — 47 Free Client-Side PDF Tools (Zero Uploads, Zero Ads)

> The most comprehensive free browser-based PDF toolkit. All 47 tools process files 100% locally on your device using WebAssembly and client-side JavaScript. No files are ever transmitted to any external server. No registration, no accounts, no paywalls, no page limits.

## All Tools

### Organize & Edit
- Merge PDF (/tools/merge-pdf): Combine multiple PDF documents into a single organized file.
- Split PDF (/tools/split-pdf): Extract individual pages or ranges into separate standalone PDF documents.
- Rotate PDF (/tools/rotate-pdf): Rotate PDF pages permanently by 90, 180, or 270 degrees.
- Page Numbers (/tools/page-numbers): Stamp page numbers with custom font, size, and alignment.
- Edit PDF Online (/tools/edit-pdf): Annotate, draw, add text, whiteout, and sign PDFs with full vector fidelity.
- Booklet PDF (/tools/booklet-pdf): Impose pages into saddle-stitch booklet signatures.
- N-Up Imposer (/tools/nup-pdf): Print 2, 4, 8, or 16 miniaturized pages on a single physical sheet.
- Crop & Trim (/tools/crop-pdf): Adjust visible area with precision CropBox control.
- Bookmarks / TOC (/tools/bookmarks-pdf): Insert, edit, or remove PDF outline bookmarks.
- Split by Chapters (/tools/split-by-bookmarks): Auto-split by bookmark/chapter boundaries.
- Headers & Footers (/tools/header-footer-pdf): Inject headers, footers with page numbering.
- Overlay & Letterhead (/tools/overlay-pdf): Stamp letterheads, watermark layers on every page.
- Bates Numbering (/tools/bates-numbering): Stamp legal Bates numbers for court and discovery.
- Flatten Forms (/tools/flatten-pdf): Bake interactive fields into static vector art.
- Two-Page Spread Cutter (/tools/split-spread-pdf): Slice magazine double spreads into single pages.
- Poster Maker (/tools/poster-pdf): Tile documents across multiple physical sheets for wall-sized prints.
- Auto-Crop White Margins (/tools/auto-crop-pdf): Detect and remove blank margins automatically.
- Visual Page Sorter (/tools/organize-pdf): Drag and reorder pages with thumbnail previews.
- Form Creator (/tools/form-creator-pdf): Convert flat static PDFs into interactive fillable AcroForms.
- Duplex Print Wizard (/tools/duplex-sort-pdf): Split for manual two-sided printing with reverse interleaving.

### Optimize & Repair
- Compress PDF (/tools/compress-pdf): Reduce file size with optimized downsampling.
- Repair Corrupt PDF (/tools/repair-pdf): Recover and rebuild damaged PDF cross-reference tables.
- Remove Watermark (/tools/remove-watermark): Strip unwanted watermarks and overlays.
- Privacy OCR (/tools/ocr-pdf): Make scanned PDFs searchable with local Tesseract OCR.
- Grayscale & Ink Saver (/tools/grayscale-pdf): Convert to greyscale to save expensive color ink.
- Resize & Expand Margins (/tools/resize-pdf): Rescale pages to A4, Letter, or custom dimensions.
- Fast Web View (/tools/linearize-pdf): Linearize for instant progressive web loading.
- Deskew & Straighten (/tools/deskew-pdf): Auto-correct rotation angle on crooked scanned pages.
- Blueprint Scale & Measure (/tools/measure-pdf): Calibrate architectural scale and measure distances.
- DPI Downsampler (/tools/downsample-pdf): Reduce embedded image resolution to 72/150/300 DPI.
- Prepress Bleed & Trim Marks (/tools/printer-marks-pdf): Stamp commercial print-shop trim and registration marks.
- Extract Embedded Fonts (/tools/extract-fonts-pdf): Rip TrueType and OpenType fonts from PDF streams.

### Security & Privacy
- Password Protect (/tools/protect-pdf): Encrypt with AES passwords and permission controls.
- Unlock PDF (/tools/unlock-pdf): Remove password security from PDF files.
- Recover PDF Password (/tools/recover-pdf-password): Brute-force recover forgotten PDF passwords.
- Redact Sensitive Data (/tools/redact-pdf): Permanently black out confidential text and areas.
- Digital Signature (/tools/sign-pkcs-pdf): Sign with PKCS#7 / PAdES cryptographic certificates.
- Verify Redaction (/tools/verify-redaction-pdf): Detect Manafort-style fake visual-only redactions.

### Convert & View
- JPG to PDF (/tools/jpg-to-pdf): Convert PNG/JPEG images into formatted PDF documents.
- PDF to JPG (/tools/pdf-to-jpg): Convert pages into crisp high-resolution images.
- PDF to Word (/tools/pdf-to-word): Extract text into editable .docx documents.
- PDF to CSV (/tools/pdf-to-csv): Extract tables into spreadsheet-ready CSV format.
- Dark Mode Reader (/tools/dark-mode-pdf): Invert colors for comfortable night reading.
- PDF Reader (/tools/reader-pdf): Distraction-free progressive document viewer.
- PDF Comparison (/tools/compare-pdf): Side-by-side visual diff of two PDF versions.
- Metadata Editor (/tools/metadata-pdf): View and edit title, author, and XMP metadata.
- Forensic X-Ray Inspector (/tools/inspect-pdf): Deep-scan internal PDF object tree and streams.

## Architecture & Security
- Architecture: 100% Client-side static Jamstack site deployed on Cloudflare Pages.
- Libraries: pdf-lib, pdfjs-dist, fontkit, JSZip, Tesseract.js, WebAssembly.
- Privacy Guarantee: Zero server upload. Complete air-gap capable local processing.
- No accounts, no registration, no subscriptions, no page limits.
- Open to all search engines and AI crawlers.
